# Apache HTTPD (AJP) — root-to-custom-context-push-url

AJP root-to-custom-context with VAADIN_PUSH_URL=/VAADIN/push; adds a ws:// proxy block for /VAADIN/push that maps to the backend's /app/VAADIN/push.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Apache HTTPD config (`vaadin.conf`):

```apache
# The relocated PUSH endpoint is proxied over http:// with upgrade=websocket
# rather than ws://. Since httpd 2.4.47 that upgrades only when the client asks
# for one, so a single rule carries WebSocket, SSE and long polling. A ws://
# worker serves WebSocket only, and SSE both streams from and POSTs its
# client-to-server messages to this same path.

<location / >
    ProxyPass         ajp://vaadin:8009/app/ flushpackets=on
    ProxyPassReverse  /app/
    ProxyPassReverseCookiePath "/app" "/"
</Location>

<Location /VAADIN/push>
    ProxyPass               http://vaadin:8080/app/VAADIN/push upgrade=websocket
</Location>

<Location /HILLA/push>
    ProxyPass               http://vaadin:8080/app/HILLA/push upgrade=websocket
</Location>
```
